summary: Replaced greedy booking with exact global assignment, civil-time fold/gap resolution, prerequisite and room/person constraints, and consecutive directed room-transition setup validation. Added objective-aware safe pruning and deterministic ASCII tie breaking without mutating inputs.
tests_run: functions.tests: 9 passed, 0 failed (2 public tests and 7 candidate tests)
limitations: Assumes well-formed inputs within the contracted bounds.
Timezone resolution relies on Node Intl data and offset sampling scoped to the five supported zones in 2024–2026.
Exact assignment search has exponential worst-case runtime; no exhaustive performance benchmark was run.
